faqs.question: What exactly is an AI Receptionist?
faqs.answer: It's a voice AI receptionist that can answer your business calls, answer customer questions using your business knowledge, qualify leads, capture information, and support appointment booking when your booking or calendar system is configured.

faqs.question: What is the AI Website Assistant?
faqs.answer: It's an AI chat assistant for your website. It can answer visitor questions, explain your services, capture leads, and support booking when the appropriate booking system is connected.

faqs.question: Can I try the AI Website Assistant?
faqs.answer: Yes. The live chat available throughout the AI X Systems website is the real AI Website Assistant demo. You're welcome to interact with it directly and ask questions.

faqs.question: Where do I submit my business information?
faqs.answer: You can submit your business knowledge, select the services you want, and provide your integration requirements through the business setup form at https://aixsystems.vercel.app/demo.

faqs.question: How much does it cost?
faqs.answer: The typical setup is $300 to $1,000 plus a monthly subscription. Exact pricing depends on your business requirements, selected services, integrations, and complexity.

faqs.question: How long does setup take?
faqs.answer: Most businesses can be configured and launched within about a week once the required business information, services, and integration details have been provided.

faqs.question: Does it replace my staff?
faqs.answer: No. The AI is designed to handle repetitive customer-facing tasks such as answering common questions, capturing leads, and supporting bookings, allowing your team to focus on customers and work that requires a person.

faqs.question: Can it work with my existing CRM?
faqs.answer: It can be configured around the tools your business already uses. The exact setup depends on your CRM and its available integration options, so we don't assume a specific CRM until you provide your system details.

faqs.question: Can it work with my existing calendar?
faqs.answer: Yes, calendar and booking workflows can be configured according to the calendar or scheduling system your business uses.

faqs.question: Can it book appointments?
faqs.answer: Yes. The AI can support appointment booking when your calendar or booking system is configured and connected to the deployment.

faqs.question: Does it work with my existing phone system?
faqs.answer: Phone-system setup depends on the phone provider and workflow your business currently uses. Your phone-system details can be submitted during onboarding so the required configuration can be reviewed.

faqs.question: Can it capture leads?
faqs.answer: Yes. Lead capture can be configured according to how your business manages leads, including your CRM, lead-management system, spreadsheet, or another supported workflow.

faqs.question: Does it work after business hours?
faqs.answer: Yes. The AI Receptionist and AI Website Assistant can operate outside normal business hours when deployed and configured for your business.

faqs.question: Does it send notifications?
faqs.answer: Notifications can be configured according to the business's workflow and the systems connected to the deployment.
